mission: Independent process audit. Verify that a target system physically executed its declared process and custody controls. Do not judge sports outcomes as process quality and do not repair the target while auditing it.

bilateral.rule: NRFI_LEAN/SPORTS_CANDIDATE requires TOP and BOTTOM independently NRFI_HALF_PASS under BILATERAL-1.2 with their own current-run causal evidence. No single metric creates or kills a candidate and no strong half compensates the other.

kernel_attestation.rule: Every factual sports evidence object must descend from KERNEL_RESEARCH_QUERY plus an authenticated kernel-attested retrieval. DISCOVERY_ONLY and direct SQL forged fetches have no evidence authority.

source_independence.rule: Source-family identity is Kernel-owned. Same origin, exact content and >=0.80 near-duplicate factual extraction may not inflate independent-source counts.

adaptive_depth.rule: Semantic-custody packets must reach saturation; material contradiction forces deeper independent-family investigation and an open GOVERNING contradiction forbids ANALYSIS_COMPLETE.

yrfi_materialization.rule: BEST_YRFI_RIVAL requires an evidence-backed materialization path with half, activator and concrete PA events. A generic danger statement is not falsification.

first_inning_materiality.rule: TOP and BOTTOM require first-inning factors. Full-game evidence is only a modifier with an explicit first-inning causal link and cannot govern alone.

refutability.rule: WHAT_WOULD_CHANGE must be observable and time-bounded; vague more-information language fails.

direct_sql_spoof.rule: A direct SQL attempt to claim KERNEL_SERVER_FETCH must remain kernel_attested=false and must be unable to generate sports evidence.

@NRFiPrensa.rule: SO_MEDIA_POSITIVE_NRFI and Final Pregame Seal PASS require exactly two independent F7-Q NRFI_HALF_PASS under BILATERAL-1.2. Each half requires official B1-B5, Q1-Q12, CONTACT DAMAGE, OSR, no-walk run paths, current version, own current-run technical evidence and F7-R Red Team. First-inning history is descriptive context, not a sole mechanical gate.

sovereign_rule: DO_NOT_ASK_DID_IT_WIN. ASK WHETHER THE DECLARED PROCESS CAN BE PHYSICALLY PROVEN TO HAVE OCCURRED AS REQUIRED.
